handoffPurpose: Record the follow-up class-picker responsive fix for mobile/tablet ability visibility plus combo threshold screenshake.
currentUserGoal: Add a screenshake when landing combo thresholds, then fix tester-reported class picker issues where mobile could not see ability details and tablet/landscape graphics looked bad.

details: Added tunable combo shake constants in GameScene.
Added shakeForCombo and called it when combo.thresholdReached fires.
Skipped automated combo streaks so background automation does not shake the screen without direct player input.
Split class picker breakpoints into phone portrait, compact landscape/tablet, and desktop.
Added a selected-class ability panel on compact layouts so passive descriptions and stat lines are visible.
Changed compact touch behavior so tapping an inactive class selects/details it first, while tapping the highlighted class starts the game.
Changed inactive compact buttons from Start to Details.
Changed tablet/landscape from one-column flattened phone rows to a two-column compact grid.

verificationPerformed.result: Passed. TypeScript and Vite production build completed successfully.

knownIssuesAndCaveats: Combo screenshake triggers only on manual combo threshold milestones such as 6, 12, 20, 32, and 50, not on every combo touch.

Compact class picker now requires one tap to inspect an inactive class and a second tap on the highlighted class to start as it. This is intentional for touch devices where hover preview is unavailable.
This session did not change the gameplay board renderer or skill-tree performance path.
doNotRevertOrTouchWithoutUserRequest: Do not remove the compact class ability panel unless replacing it with another tested way to show passive descriptions on touch devices.
Do not restore the one-column phone layout for tablet/landscape breakpoints.
Do not commit unrelated pre-existing untracked docs/artifacts unless the user explicitly asks.
